summary.content:
Today's selection covers 98 articles from 8 trusted sources, including 65 on Artificial Intelligence and 21 on Fraud/Cybersecurity.

• **AI Spotlight**: OpenAI’s Two-Week Pause + Jill Lepore on the Threat of the “Artificial State” + Train of Thought
• **Companies in Focus**: Coverage includes developments from OpenAI, Google, Anthropic
• **Security Alert**: Hackers abuse FTP server banners to deliver new Windows malware
• **Threat Landscape**: Today's coverage highlights phishing, data breaches, malware
• **Source Diversity**: Articles sourced from NY Times Tech, Dark Reading, SecurityWeek, TechCrunch, BleepingComputer and others
• **Fresh Content**: 49 articles published in the last 24 hours
